speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent; to begin our assessment, please tell me how old you are and describe your main symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Tetanus. Based on the history of no prenatal care, unavailable immunization records, and the newborn status, clinical suspicion is high for tetanus caused by an unsterile cord clamping, especially given the absence of maternal immunization.
